svg.aria-label: Starting Omnipus: from `omnipus gateway` to a server that answers, and what it does with work the last run left behind
svg.text: if: a single reference cannot be resolved
else: the whole store is unreadable (wrong key, damaged file)
if: kernel does not know the requested Landlock rights
else: any other Landlock failure on a capable kernel
if: every configured chat-app channel fails to start, or the port is taken
SIGINT/SIGTERM cancel one root context; every later
create logs/, panic log, gateway.log; create the data folders
only if credentials.json does not exist · 5 passphrase,
only on a terminal. An explicit source that fails is
fatal; it never falls through to auto-generate
logged at ERROR; that provider / channel / mailbox stays
or its key is unusable, start
NewAgentLoop: one shared session store, agent registry, fallback chain,
harden the server: PR_SET_DUMPABLE=0, then Landlock, then seccomp
degrade to app-level enforcement, nag banner
boot aborts with SandboxBootError (its own exit code)
Before any task producer starts: tasks the dead process
left in_progress are set to failed (interrupted-task
text) and their open runs are closed on a best-effort
basis (status failed, with the abandonment wording in
the result text); interrupted one-time Calendar fires
are classified so an owed fire can run again
start cron (restores only the dead run's flags), reconcile heartbeat schedules per workspace, start task drain, mail watcher,
create channel manager (owns the HTTP server) and the chat-app channels
5 · Recovery of the last run's work
boot hook: classify every saved session and settle it
ordinary conversation that was running, queued or waiting for an answer: write a 'restart' Stop; the
helper (steered) sessions: deliver a finished result upward; revive an eligible native delegated helper
that the restart stopped (resumeRestartHelper); otherwise a helper interrupted mid-run is stopped with
cause restart; damaged or unknown records are refused and named in the log
Not revived: third-party helpers, task-origin runs and
helpers with an accepted human Stop still pending (these
return before any refusal row is written). Helpers whose
agent or workspace is no longer valid, or whose revival
or dispatch fails, are not revived either; for them the
code attempts to save a visible refusal row and only
logs if that save fails. A task-origin run follows the
task's own restart rule instead: its session stays
finish Stop requests that were accepted but never took effect
recovery errors are logged; they never stop boot
start plan engine: replay its intent log, then bootReconcile re-runs processPlan for every running plan (a judging round resumes;
an awaiting_supervision plan with an unchanged unmet signature is not re-judged); then the boot sweep settles leftover running or
queued parentless non-standing sessions as failed(interrupted) within a budget (default 30 s); steered (helper and MAIN-mode task)
sessions are skipped here because the steer recovery owns them
Sweep exemptions (not failed): a needs-input session
that can still be rebuilt; a paused plan-owner session
whose plan is awaiting_supervision; a standing root
conversation (no helper edge; origin chat, channel,
main, heartbeat or scheduled), which ordinary-root
recovery handles separately; helper sessions, which
wrap the router: CSRF -> planted-cookie guard -> navigation guard -> preview host dispatch; sign-in is checked per route class inside the route table (open
boot aborts ('error starting channels'); the web app is
not reachable either, because it shares this server
start agent loop goroutine: initialise hooks and MCP servers, then read the
background: retention sweeps (daily), catch-up recaps for sessions missing
if hot reload is on: poll config.json and apply
